in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed both sides at 581.90; monetary-plus-in-kind was tested and is identical, because no row is marked in-kind and this form prints no in-kind column or line. The single Schedule A entry is headed 'Loan to campaign' by the filer — a LOAN, not an in-kind gift — and is transcribed as the money entry the filer made, not reclassified.
escalation_note: Three tight cell crops at 900 dpi, all geometry/legibility proofs rather than arithmetic (the arithmetic closed on the printed subtotals first): p3 band 3 rendered '581.90'; p4 band 2 rendered '519.48'; p4 band 6 rendered '5.34'. These also settled a per-filing property: on THIS filing the first written entry sits in the SECOND band (the filer skipped the first ruled line), whereas on the same-family 2008 Ellertson filing the first entry sits in the extrapolated first band — the first-row position is a filer habit and must be crop-proved per page, never assumed.

THE TEXT SITS ABOVE ITS UNDERLINE, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N]; row 1 is extrapolated one pitch up to [14.97, 19.07] and is EMPTY on this page. Row 2 carries the filer's heading 'Loan to campaign' in the Name column with no date and no amount; row 3 carries the entry. PROOF at 900 dpi: the only transcribed row's box pct:84.99,23.17,10.24,4.05@p3 rendered '581.90' (recorded 581.90), and a control crop of the extrapolated row-1 box pct:84.99,14.97,10.24,4.10@p3 rendered only the PRINTED 'Amount' column header over an empty cell — no handwriting at all — confirming the entry is in band 3 and the band list is not shifted up.

4.measure_note: Same underline grid as p3; 17 rules at 19.39, 23.44, 27.51, 31.59, 35.66, 39.71, ... pitch 4.06, row 1 extrapolated one pitch up to [15.34, 19.39] and EMPTY (this filer starts writing on the second ruled line). contributions.note: DATE IS A MONTH RANGE, not a day-precise date: the filer wrote 'Mar-Apr 2010' and it is kept VERBATIM (needs_review=1 for the build, which cannot normalize it — no day was ever printed and none is invented). The filer wrote 'Loan to campaign' as a heading on the ruled line immediately ABOVE this entry (row 2, which carries no date and no amount) — so this single 581.90 line is the candidate's and her husband's own LOAN to the campaign, reported on Schedule A as the filer chose to report it; it is not reclassified here. expenditures.note: Schedule B on this form prints no Purpose column (Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount) and this filer wrote no purpose text, so purpose is honestly blank. Amount is the candidate filing fee.
